scope.description: Installed Zed 10x desktop and remote external-agent discovery, launch, reconnect, and cleanup across Mac-local and Mac-to-Intrepid projects

nativeCommands: rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p project remote_external_agent
rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p remote_server remote_external_agent
toolGaps: cargo is not on the ambient PATH; rustup provides the pinned 1.95.0 toolchain
native installed-app UI control requires explicit per-action Mac permission

3-implementation.redEvidence: The server-first remote external-agent fixture returned an empty inventory before the protocol correction.
3-implementation.greenEvidence: Server-first recovery, reconnect-after-disconnected-settings-change, request/push ordering, and post-handler settings refresh pass after the receiver-driven snapshot correction. The tracked ACP canary's ten deterministic tests prove a withheld filesystem oracle, prompt-echo and marker-only refusal, permission refusal, failure classification, JSONC settings loading, and timeout process-group cleanup. A live direct Codex Mac (primary) route then computed the withheld Cargo.toml digest through a completed ACP tool call and cleaned up, recorded at docs/test-results/acp-route-codex-mac-primary.json.
3-implementation.remainingEvidence: Execute the installed Zed Mac-local and Mac-to-Intrepid project journeys with explicit per-action Mac app-control permission.

fixedDuringRun: Replaced the one-second initial inventory push guess with a receiver-driven request/response snapshot, re-request on rejoin, and stale-response suppression.
Promoted the project-aware ACP route oracle into tracked code with a withheld digest, fail-closed permissions, and deterministic false-green and cleanup tests.
knownDefects: Initial ExternalAgentsUpdated can arrive before client handler registration and is not replayed
Prior ACP live canary launched host commands directly instead of exercising the installed Zed client-to-remote-server journey
